🏆 Steam Awards 2026 nominations are open — and it is the 10th anniversary!

Valve just kicked off nominations for the 2026 Steam Awards, running today (Nov 23) through November 30. To mark 10 years, two new categories join the lineup:
🎮 "This Is My Job Now" — for games you sink into like a second job (farming, management, logistics, and other glorious grinds)
🏛️ "Hall of Fame of the Hall of Fame" — past winners go back on the ballot for the anniversary

There is no jury here — Steam users handle both nominating and voting. Voting opens December 17, alongside the Steam Winter Sale.

🕐 Published: 08:02 GMT+3, November 23, 2026

📰 Sources: Steam Awards (official), gg.deals, spotgeeks.news

👥 x.com/Steam

🎮 Which game are you nominating this year? Drop your picks below!
